summary: Fluence Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K covering a secondary underwritten public offering of 20,000,000 shares (plus 3,000,000 overallotment exercised) of Class A common stock by selling stockholders including AES Grid Stability, SPT Holding, and Qatar Holding LLC at $21.00 per share. The company did not sell any shares and will not receive proceeds. Separately, AES Grid Stability redeemed 10,066,414 common units which the company settled by issuing an equal number of Class A shares. Both transactions are routine capital-structure events — a shelf takedown and a contractual unit redemption — not a special situation. No change of control, premium, board recommendation, or deal structure is present.
